content.text: leia o diálogo uma vez. Antes, dê 1 minuto para o aluno ler o formulário e prever.
Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

Name: Ana (1) ______ · Nationality: (2) ______ · Date of birth: (3) ______ · Course: (4) ______ English · Level: (5) ______ · Start date: (6) ______ · Classes per week: (7) ______ · Fee per week: £(8) ______ · Accommodation: with a (9) ______ · Contact email: ana.(10) ______@webmail.com
Good morning, Hillside Language School. How can I help?
Hi, I'd like to enrol on one of your courses.
Lovely. Can I have your name?
Which course are you interested in — General English, Business English or Academic English?
I was thinking of Business English, but actually I need it for university, so Academic, please.
Fine. We'll do a test on your first day, but what level do you think you are?
The next course starts on the 4th of September… sorry, no — the 11th. The 4th is full.
You'll have 15 classes a week — three each morning, Monday to Friday. The fee is £240 a week, but students who book more than four weeks get a discount, so it'd be £215.
I'm booking six weeks, so that's great.
Do you need accommodation? We can offer a room in a student residence or with a host family.
A family, please. I want to practise my English at home.
Perfect. And finally, an email address?
It's ana dot pereira98 at webmail dot com.
